dedupe_keys.name: ssp cabra brazilian catchment streamflow projections

description: Zenodo publishes SSP-CABra, daily simulated streamflow for 735 Brazilian catchments. The repository describes five hydrological models forced by ten bias-corrected CMIP6 climate simulations for 1980–2013 historical and 2015–2100 future periods under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5. The current resolving release lists projected-streamflow, catchment-attribute, readme and evaluation-metric archives under CC BY 4.0, free to obtain. These ensembles can test reservoir supply, hydropower and flood-control decisions across plausible future climates. They are model outputs, not direct gauge observations or probabilities of a specific future. Bias correction, model structure and regional calibration affect their spread. A user must inspect the readme, station identifiers and each version's file layout before joining catchments to infrastructure. The concept DOI currently resolves to a later release than the version DOI printed in the article. The data complement data-brazil-ana-hidroweb-hydrometeorological-network, which contains observational hydrometeorological records. No archive was downloaded.
